scoring_justification: Checker recomputes MAE from sqs_predictions.csv and applies threshold_or_better policy against paper-reported value plus tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: MAE threshold (0.014 eV/atom) derived from paper-reported ALIGNN relaxed Ordered→SQS MAE of 0.009 eV/atom plus tolerance 0.005.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II, row 'ALIGNN Relaxed' column 'Ordered→SQS' reports MAE 0.009 eV/atom.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly uses the paper's published result; tolerance accounts for implementation variation but remains strict enough to verify meaningful generalization.

outputs.description: Per-structure predictions on the SQS test set (Ordered→SQS), used to compute out-of-distribution mean absolute error (MAE) in eV/atom.

output_contract.notes: Single scored generalization task: Ordered→SQS. The approved plan scoped this task to the Ordered→SQS out-of-distribution generalization, which is the paper's primary quantitative headline for ALIGNN. The solve infrastructure supports only the three originally configured output artifacts (split_summary.json, trained_model.pt, sqs_predictions.csv), so additional generalization tasks (Low→High, Equi→Non-equi) cannot be added without creating new solve blocks, which is a system-level change outside this repair's scope.
